scope: Proposition 5.3 (One-sided overlap for positive marked factors) of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let W contain n − t occupied cells in an a by b board, n = ab. Assume ω ⊢ n − t and every prescribed row and column type ηg are (q, q)-hook shapes: their (q + 1)st part is at most q. Here 1 ≤ q ≤ n. Suppose X = Q g row Xg and Y = Q g column Yg are positive group-algebra elements, with each Xg, Yg supported on the indicated local type. Write cg for its unnormalized trace on one copy of Vηg and S = P g log Dηg . Then Trω(XY ) ≤ (Y g cg ) exp{C(a + b + 1)q2 log(n + 1) + t + min(0, S − log Dω)}. The constant is absolute. On the ω-isotypic part of the signed tensor power, the same bound is multiplied by its multiplicity wω.
